title: Isolation and characterization of the immune cell fraction from murine brain tumor microenvironment
protocol: Anesthetize mice using a Ketamine/Xylazine mixture at a 3:1 ratio.
Dissect brain tumor tissue under sterile conditions.
Dissociate the dissected brain tumor tissue to obtain mixed cell subpopulations.
Stain cells for FACS analysis if required.
Extract RNA from the resultant cells for further analysis.
Culture cells if necessary.
Dissect brain tumors from mice aged 7–8 weeks.
Perfuse the mice with sterile ice-cold PBS.
Isolate the brain and transfer it to a sterile 10 cm transparent plate.
Dissect the brain tumors under a fluorescent microscope.
Transfer the tumor to a well of a 6-well plate containing cold HBSS−/−.
Dissociate tumor tissue using a Neural Dissociation Kit according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Prepare enzyme 1 mix according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Warm up enzyme 1 mix in C tubes for 15 minutes.
Aspirate HBSS−/− and cut the tumor into small pieces (2–3mm).
Add enzyme 1 mix on top of chopped dissected tissue, then transfer it back to C tube.
Run “m_brain_01” protocol on gentleMACS™ tissue dissociator.
Incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes.
Run “m_brain_02” protocol on gentleMACS™ tissue dissociator.
Prepare enzyme A mix according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Add enzyme A mix to the C tube containing tissue homogenate.
Incubate at 37°C for 10 minutes.
Run “m_brain_03” protocol on gentleMACS™ tissue dissociator.
Add 3 mL of cold HBSS +/+ into C tube to stop reaction.
Transfer content from C tube into a Falcon tube through a 70μm cell strainer.
Add 3 mL of HBSS +/+ into C tube for washing and repeat step j.
Grind remaining tissue pieces against the mesh using the rubber tip of a syringe.
Spin the Falcon tube at 300g for 10 minutes.
Resuspend the pellet in a percoll gradient mix (25 mL).
Add 5 mL of cold PBS slowly on top to create the gradient.
Spin for 20 minutes at 950g without breaking the centrifuge run.
Aspirate the myelin layer first, then remove the rest of the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Vacuum the myelin layer to ensure no contamination from other layers.
Resuspend the myelin in 0.5% BSA in 1× PBS at a volume of 10 mL for each brain.
Count the cells and divide them according to the column’s capacity.
Take 1 million cells to stain with CD45 to estimate % of total CD45+ cells in the tumor.
Transfer the cells to 15mL Falcon tubes.
Spin the cells at 300g for 10 min.
Resuspend each pellet in 90μl of 0.5% BSA in PBS.
Add 10μl of CD45 microbeads.
Incubate 15 min at 4°C.
Wash with 1 mL of 0.5% BSA.
Centrifuge sample for 10 minutes at 300g.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 500 μL of 0.5% BSA.
Set up MS columns against the magnet stand and a falcon tube beneath it to collect CD45- cell fractions.
Equilibrate the MS columns with 500 μL of 0.5% BSA.
Filter the cell suspension through a 70 μm mesh.
Add the filtered cell suspension to the column.
Wash the column three times with 500 μL of 0.5% BSA each time.
Collect eluate in a 15 mL Falcon tube.
Take the MS Column out of the magnetic stand.
Quickly add 1 mL of 0.5% BSA into it and immediately flush out retained fraction into a new Falcon tube labeled CD45+.
Stain the enriched cells for flow cytometry analysis to determine TME’s myeloid and lymphoid composition.
Count the cells and divide them according to the number of antibody panels in use.
Keep some cells for unstained or other necessary controls.
Spin the cells down in an Eppendorf centrifuge for 5 min at 400g.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 μL of FACS buffer.
Add 1 μL of eFlour-405 Live/Dead Fixable dye per million cells.
Incubate at 4°C for 30 min.
Wash and spin the samples down with 1 mL of FACS buffer for 5 min at 400g.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 μL of FACS buffer.
Add 1 μL of TruStainFcXTM-Fc blocker CD16/32 per million cells.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 min.
Wash and spin the samples down with 1 mL of FACS buffer for 5 min at 400g.
Resuspend in 300 μL of FACS buffer.
Stain the samples with anti-mouse antibodies according to the table below for 30 min at 4°C.
Read each sample on an Attune NxT Flow Cytometer.
Perform analysis using Kaluza software v2.1.
Determine the composition of the TME according to the gating strategy.
